name: lightcone
description: Work with a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis using the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain. The `start` skill inspects project state and routes — scoping a new analysis from a research question, or surfacing the next step (run/verify outputs, refine decisions, write narrative, publish) on an existing one — and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project. The `start` skill bundles the full lc CLI reference (references/cli.md).
